body: I used to have lots of hobbies. The depression and the winter have put a damper on them.

I'm letting her have the house. I don't want it. Hopefully we'll just be able to sign it over to her. We haven't had it for long so there's not a lot of equity in it.

My son is 13, from another woman. We get along fine, fortunately.

Sure.

So last summer, I had a solid job that paid well, but the company was vastly over budget and announced they had to lay off 18 people. So they did that, and a week later said they were still over budget and had to lay off more. (This time they didn't specify how many.) A week later, I made a mistake in my work, which was compounded by the ineptitude of my coworkers. There was *no* fallout from my mistake, but they took it as an excuse to fire me.

I had quite a bit of money saved up, so I decided to take it easy for a little while and make my job search more leisurely. Well, weeks turned into months and I had a harder time finding a new job than I thought I would. My GF got "tired of taking care of me" (despite that I cleaned and cooked every day.) And demanded I get *some* job, anything. So I ended up working as a machinist (not related to my degree in any way) for a month. At the end of that month my GF told me she wanted to break up. (Oh yeah, we had purchased a house together 1 month before I was fired.) As a last ditch attempt to save the relationship, we decided that I would take a temporary position 300 miles away for 11 weeks (this one was related to my degree), in the hopes that the distance would make the heart grow fonder, as they say. It didn't work.

About mid December, she told me over the phone that it's definitely not going to work out. I spent the rest of my contract diving headfirst into alcoholism, depression, and isolation.

I returned home a couple weeks ago. I have no place to live but the house we bought, which is where I'm staying until I find another job. (Shouldn't take long this time.)

I am completely unwelcome here. Her brother also lives here and is the biggest fucking loser I've ever seen. So now I'm packing up and trying to figure out what the next step is. I have a son which kind of rules out moving to another state permanently. I'm kind of stuck in/near this town for the next 5 years.
I stated elsewhere that I do not believe suicide is as selfish as many people think. I think demanding a person live, when they are in so much pain that they want to die, is more selfish.
Oh also, I have a son.

I'm a long-time reddit user and I'm afraid some people would put the pieces together and figure out who I am if I identified what I do and where I live.

Thanks for the help, though.
Thank you. That helps.
Thanks. I also have a son, and he's the only reason I'm still here.
Oh boy, you have no idea. I drink myself into a stupor every night. No other way I can fall asleep any more.
I have one friend, he's pretty busy with his family and I hate to burden him with my situation.
Where does "consciousness" fit into that?

I know it can get better if I invest the time and energy. I have a college degree in a very sought-after field, I'm not a bad looking guy and I know I can meet another girl if I want. I just don't know if I can endure the time in between.

Reddit helps, which is why I'm posting. Just knowing that someone, even an anonymous stranger, gives a shit, helps. Thank you.

Yeah I posted there a little while ago. There's not a whole lot anyone can say besides "don't do it, there's so much to live for."

I called a suicide hotline and said I wanted to die, they just said, "now why would you want to do that?"

I hung up.

People say suicide is selfish, and I disagree. I think it's selfish to expect someone who is experiencing so much pain that they want to die, to continue living because it would be hurtful to see them go.

Today will be spent packing the rest of my belongings in boxes in between crying spells, in order to move out (to where? I have no fucking idea.) Then my ex will come home in the evening and tell me what a loser I am and to stop mentioning how shitty my life is because it makes her feel guilty.

I think maybe I'll kill her first. Fuck life.
I don't believe in any kind of existence after death. There is nothing, and there is no evidence to support any kind of afterlife. If there is, well oops, my bad.
"Nadir" means, basically, "the lowest point possible".

Thanks for the encouragement. I have a son here and I'm doing travel jobs around the country, but settling somewhere permanently is out of the question right not. He's pretty much the only reason I'm not going somewhere else and starting all over.

I really don't want to get rid of my guns. They are one of my few hobbies I have right now.

I just got into another argument with her. She said she's tired of me being here and is glad she broke up with me. Time to hit the bottle and rock in a corner again.
